page.layout: One column of italic verse, full width, running from the top of the page to its foot; below the last line, at the right, a catchword. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Spurcans salivis; neu loquax strepat caelo
Ostendere edita templa, ne boni vultum
Non aliter animo sic recepit in terris
Pavitque mentem. Porta cui poli tanto
Cortina in adyta quem profundius misit
Quae Caelitum gens ipsa cernua gestit
Inspexe fronte? Namque grandibus quis non
Choragium omne, tota quo stetit quondam
Ac vota, longe edisseris, tot umbrarum
Telam affabre dum denique, o adorande

page.notes: Two small printed marks above the catchword line (a pair of brackets, likely a signature or printer's mark) are not transcribed. Line "Doctrina" and "Doctrina"/"Dostrina" and "Inspexe" are as read from the scan; "trahta" and "Dedalo" are uncertain (see also "Pretium" line). The catchword "Di" is partly cut off at the edge. Handwritten pencil marks and a bracket in the right margin are not printed text and are omitted.
